mapper.sql: product_code, product_type, insurance_period, insured_amount, premium, maturity_refund, driver_age, vehicle_type, building_type, location, vessel_type, shipping_route
mapper.select: SELECT FROM insurance WHERE product_code = #{productCode} AND product_type IN ('AUTO', 'FIRE', 'MARINE')
SELECT FROM insurance WHERE product_type IN ('AUTO', 'FIRE', 'MARINE') ORDER BY product_code
SELECT product_code FROM insurance ORDER BY product_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance (product_code, product_type, insurance_period, insured_amount, premium, maturity_refund, driver_age, vehicle_type, building_type, location, vessel_type, shipping_route) VALUES (#{ins.productCode}, #{productType}, #{ins.insurancePeriod}, #{ins.insuredAmount}, #{ins.premium}, #{ins.maturityRefund}, #{driverAge}, #{vehicleType}, #{buildingType}, #{location}, #{vesselType}, #{shippingRoute})
mapper.update: UPDATE insurance SET product_type = #{productType}, insurance_period = #{ins.insurancePeriod}, insured_amount = #{ins.insuredAmount}, premium = #{ins.premium}, maturity_refund = #{ins.maturityRefund}, driver_age = #{driverAge}, vehicle_type = #{vehicleType}, building_type = #{buildingType}, location = #{location}, vessel_type = #{vesselType}, shipping_route = #{shippingRoute} WHERE product_code = #{ins.productCode}
